create_scene_with_entities: create a Scene instance and add entities with name, position, rotation, and parent parameters
set_transforms_on_entities: set transforms on a list of entities using Scene.SetTransforms with a dictionary mapping
get_transforms_from_entities: get transform tensors for a list of entities or indices using Scene.GetTransforms
get_skinning_transforms: get skinning transforms with position, rotation, and scale using Scene.GetSkinningTransforms
update_and_draw_scene: update all entities in the scene and draw the hierarchy, handles, and labels
